citations.assessment: In the narrative Rav Naḥman requests a blessing, and Yitzḥak answers with the parable of the tree and a blessing for his descendants. Keep the title form in Heilprin’s heading.

holds.reason: The blessing narrative does not establish Heilprin’s separate colleague identification. Keep the claim attributed.
A precise internal Naḥman locator for the blessing was not established. The primary blessing is separately linked.
